narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.80 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 1.497-1.528 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 1.536; the first objective pays 0.92R at 1.489.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 1.536 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 31/100 — trend broken, flow confirming, liq magnets below
